authority: accepted source files only; this catalogue is a task universe, never an answer oracle
partition_rule: Exactly the listed C-* task identities are calibration. Exactly the listed A-* identities are the untouched acceptance pool. Identity and partition never change because of observations. No calibration task may become an acceptance task.
acceptance_selection_rule: After CTX-only calibration readiness, select lexicographically the first three A-CITY-* and first three A-PA-* identities from this frozen untouched pool: exactly six; A-*-04 are reserves and cannot replace a selected task because of result. Only a reviewed source-truth contradiction or mechanical unscorability independent of model outcome can amend selection before acceptance under the WP rule.

calibration_policy.route: CTX only; neither acceptance task prompts nor DW retrieval may execute during calibration
calibration_policy.proof_budget: Exactly eight designated calibration model calls; only objectively invalid calls may be retried once each if a transport/provider error occurred before a scorable structured answer, with the original invalid receipt retained.
calibration_policy.readiness: All eight designated CTX runs yield a parseable canonical structured answer, satisfy the predeclared calibration fact/blocker/verdict oracle, and record model configuration and input usage if reported. A semantic miss prevents acceptance freeze; no selective run extension.

oracle_construction: Before calibration calls, freeze calibration expected canonical values by directly reading the pinned accepted source anchors. After calibration readiness and before any acceptance call, freeze every selected acceptance task's prompt, expected canonical fact ID/value, causal blocker ID, verdict token and evidence ID from these exact accepted anchors; never infer expected claims from CTX/DW output. The accepted source and its Git blob plus exact section/row or fixture key must be attached to each expected item. Scorer semantics and all run/configuration/route policies are frozen in the same pre-result TASK_SELECTION_FREEZE.
